# TokenSaver CLI — llms.txt
# https://github.com/tokensaver-ai/tokensaver-cli
# Product: https://tokensaver.fr · Console: https://platform.tokensaver.fr
# Platform Docs: https://platform.tokensaver.fr (sidebar Docs → Build / Connect)

> Open-source CLI (`tokensaver-cli`, command `tokensaver`) — one on-ramp to the
> TokenSaver governed control plane. Same plane via LLM egress, Python SDK/REST,
> MCP tools, and Trust Gateway. MIT. Python ≥ 3.10. Stdlib only.

## Install & 60-second start (CLI path)

pip install -U tokensaver-cli
tokensaver login
tokensaver route claude --launch
tokensaver doctor --claude
tokensaver flows --open

## Connect paths (same control plane)

- CLI (this repo): tokensaver route claude|cursor|codex|proxy|mcp
- LLM egress OpenAI-shaped: https://api.tokensaver.fr/openai/v1 + Bearer ts_…
- LLM egress Anthropic-shaped: https://api.tokensaver.fr/anthropic + Bearer ts_…
- Native API / SDK: https://api.tokensaver.fr/api/v1 · https://pypi.org/project/tokensaver-sdk/
- MCP tools (A): https://mcp.tokensaver.fr/mcp
- MCP Trust Gateway (B): https://gateway.tokensaver.fr/mcp
- A2A: console Docs → Build → A2A
- OSS guide: docs/connect-control-plane.md
- Product Docs (in console): https://platform.tokensaver.fr → Docs → Build / Connect
- Do not confuse LLM HTTP egress with MCP Gateway or A2A

## What TokenSaver is

- AI trust / governance platform (SaaS): cache, RAG, compression, PII, quotas, audit, Flux IA
- **600+ models** in Agent Registry (Pro/BYOK); **Free plan = 15 hosted models**
- Zero Trust Agent Registry for LLM models
- Console: https://platform.tokensaver.fr (signup / login)
- Flux IA (live runs): …/en/{workspaceId}/dashboard?tab=flows — CLI: tokensaver flows --open
- Agentic graph: …/en/{workspaceId}/execution-graph?period=7d

## CLI commands (high level)

- Auth: login, logout, whoami, keys list|create|revoke
- Route: route claude|cursor|codex|proxy|mcp [--launch]; unroute <target>
- Models: models, use, profiles, approve, catalog
- Observability: flows [--open], status, quota
- Health: doctor [--claude] [--local]

## Claude Code plugin

After `tokensaver route claude`, skill `tokensaver-router` slash commands:
/tokensaver-router:welcome, :models, :use, :flows, :quota, :cache, :doctor, :help

For usage / runs lists prefer Bash: `tokensaver quota` · `tokensaver flows`
(do not invent MCP tool names).

## Credentials

- File: ~/.config/tokensaver/credentials.json (mode 0600)
- Env override: TOKENSAVER_API_KEY=ts_…
- Self-host: TOKENSAVER_MODE=local or --local on commands

## OSS vs platform

- This repo (tokensaver-ai/tokensaver-cli): public mirror of packages/cli — MIT
- Platform backend/console: proprietary SaaS; CLI is the free laptop on-ramp
- Do not confuse with unrelated PyPI package name `tokensaver` (different project)
